description: Search open jobs collected from company career sites and hiring platforms, by whole words in the job title, with optional location, remote and posted-within filters. Newest first. Use it to find who is hiring for a role. Costs 1 credit per 10 jobs returned; a search with no jobs is free.

location.description: A city, region or country to match, like "Berlin".

postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

query.description: Words in the job title, like "data engineer".

name: jobs_search
title: Search jobs
